rationale_one_line: A KV-cache performance story is carried by hard numbers, so RECEIPT lets the speedups do the proving, and geominimal's Space Grotesk hard-cut grid reads like systems infrastructure.
writing_tone_notes: Bold declarative, peer-to-peer, build-in-public. Contractions where natural. Show the mechanism (cache reused, not recomputed), let the 8x and 15x land without superlatives. The contrast carries the praise.
do_rules: Lead the numbers honestly as the project's own benchmark claims
Frame the novelty as engine-independent cache reuse, not just a faster server
Keep each surface (tweet, why-this-one, scenes) on a different phrase
dont_rules: No version numbers in the caption
Do not reuse 'off the GPU' or 'warm cache' phrasing across surfaces
